experiment: STARTS S1Q: frozen S1-only Nov3 vs QAOA at N15 L3 across Q={3072,6144,12288}

hypothesis.one_sentence: Under frozen TQA-only S1 at N15 L=3, extra inclusive budget shrinks or closes the Nov3−QAOA energy gap.
hypothesis.not: No S1/S4/S8 retune. No continuation. Not a GR patch. Closing the gap is a development note only if some Q has Nov3−QAOA mean energy CI entirely below 0.

frozen_from_PR83_84_85.split: same C0 split_cap(Q, nstarts=1); K is not a naive multiple of Q=3072 K because calibration and candidates are fixed per start
frozen_from_PR83_84_85.optimizer: ordinary IID Rademacher SPSA C0, ncal=4, A=25, live per-start gain, last+Polyak, energy min

allocation.S1: One start = TQA at L=3. Full Q per cell. K from split_cap(Q, 1).
allocation.QAOA: p=L=3, same S1 split, same Q.
allocation.inclusive: All init, calibration, perturbations, candidates, failures inside Q.

selection: Lowest counted candidate energy. F post hoc, never selects.

questions.primary: For each Q, paired mean Δ(E−E0)/N of Nov3−QAOA with bootstrap 95% CI, wins, tails. F reported, not selected.
questions.secondary: Within-method improvement of Q=6144 and Q=12288 vs own Q=3072, paired on seeds.
questions.soft_note: If at some Q the Nov3−QAOA energy CI lies entirely below 0, mark that Q as a development energy-win candidate. Not a GR adoption. Otherwise report the gap vs budget honestly.

resource_gate.order: Finish Q=3072 and Q=6144 first, checkpoint, then Q=12288.
resource_gate.blocker: If estimated Q=12288 wall exceeds 30 min from the 6144 measurement, stop and report the blocker. Do not retune.

gr: Do not patch GR even if some Q is an energy-win candidate.
